headline: H200 rental index climbs +11% over 7 days to $5.40 while most other GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H200 is the only mover of note, with its market index up +11% to $5.40 across 11 providers, though RunPod Community Cloud still lists it at $3.59.
B200, H100 SXM, MI300X and A100 80GB SXM were all unchanged at +0% over 7 days, and L40S edged -1% to $1.50.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +166%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.02 and a marketplace median of $2.35.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with a market index of $3.45 and a marketplace median as low as $0.50, though only 5 providers list it.
B200 has the highest index at $7.50 but a relatively narrow +106% hyperscaler premium, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $5.98.
watch: Whether the H200's +11% weekly gain holds or spreads to adjacent GPUs like the H100 SXM and B200, which were flat at +0%.
